sections.title: Receipts
items: Receipt photo viewer updated to board 18 with "Receipt" title, kit close button, and photo-danger remove photo button (MKL-115).

sections.title: Budget
items: New envelope sheet updated to board 03 with "Assign now" amount, ready-to-assign subtitle, and circular add buttons for category suggestions (MKL-107).

sections.title: Changed
items: Resolved static analysis and test cleanups including i18n attribute linting, unexported dead symbols, Jest worker unref handling, and expanded coverage scope (MKL-124).
Reduced oversized modules (referenceData, toDraft, planned/model, and SyncSheet), splitting them by responsibility below the 400-line ceiling (MKL-123).
Validated stored JSON strings and LLM receipt responses with Zod schemas and added lint rule preventing unsafe JSON.parse casts (MKL-122).
Decoupled domain code from the UI layer, moving money formatting and currencies to domain packages with lint enforcement (MKL-120).

sections.title: Planned
items: New planned payment wizard updated to boards 23–25 with inline amount input and trailing currency, OptionTiles for frequency, "Then" schedule rows, and single-line note with tags sheet (MKL-104).

Planned schedule sheet updated to board 22 with summary callout showing next occurrences, inline frequency segmented control, interval stepper, day-of-month and nth-weekday radios, and until-date or times conditions (MKL-103).
Planned tab updated to board 19 with large title, segmented "All plans · N", amount-styled summary figures, route and category subtitles, Booked pill, and struck skipped rows (MKL-100).
Unified planned form hook and sheets between New Planned Payment wizard and Planned Item editor, removing duplicate code across the two screens (MKL-99).
Planned occurrence sheet updated to board 21 with relative day subtitle, From/To/Category rows, and an "Edit the plan" row (MKL-102).
First-time reminders intro sheet updated to board 33 with a body title, option tiles, and a text "Not now" action (MKL-96).

sections.title: Settings
items: About and help updated to board 31 with version and build number, Activity log share and clear actions, and Firefly III browser link and server version (MKL-94).
